_readme: Git #3724 — real, hand-maintained inventory of MCP servers connected to Shane's claude.ai account for chat sessions in this project. BuildConsole/ChatContextMeterScript has NO way to enumerate claude.ai's live connector list — no DOM surface renders a connector's full tool schema during a normal chat, and no API exposes it to a WebView2 host. This file is the source of truth instead, and it is re-read from disk on every context-gauge computation (ChatContextOverheadEstimator), so editing it takes effect on the very next gauge tick with no BuildConsole restart. Update it whenever a connector is added/removed/changed, or a documented server's real tool list changes. 'documented: true' servers carry REAL tool name+description text copied from an actual in-repo reference doc (sourceDoc) — never invented. 'documented: false' servers record only a real known fact (toolCount, sourced from where that count came from) with NO per-tool text, because none exists anywhere in this codebase for them; their overhead is extrapolated (see ChatContextOverheadEstimator) from the documented servers' real measured average tokens/tool, not fabricated per-tool schemas.

servers.name: shanes-git
servers.note: Real current tool surface as of Git #3709/#3697 (24 tools). The issue body's cited '18 tools' is this server's tool count from an earlier point before batch_*/get_file_contents/list_directory/search_code landed — kept here as the real, current count rather than the stale figure.

tools.name: server_status
tools.description: health check; reports patConfigured as a boolean only, never the value

tools.name: github_whoami
tools.description: proves the server-side credential works; returns identity and scopes only

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: fetch one issue by number, optional repo override

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: create an issue with title, body, milestone number, labels, optional repo

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: update title, body, milestone number, labels (full replace), or state, optional repo

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: real passthrough to GitHub's search syntax, scoped automatically to the target repo

tools.name: post_comment
tools.description: post a comment on an issue by number, optional repo

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: paginate through every comment on an issue, oldest first

tools.name: close_issue
tools.description: close an issue with a required state_reason; not_planned is rejected unless a non-empty comment is supplied

tools.name: move_to_status
tools.description: move an issue or epic to one of the real Projects v2 board columns, validated against the exact vocabulary

tools.name: get_board_status
tools.description: read counterpart to move_to_status

tools.name: list_board_column
tools.description: query the shared Projects v2 board node directly for every issue in one status column

tools.name: add_sub_issue
tools.description: attach a child issue under a parent, real sub-issue hierarchy

tools.name: remove_sub_issue
tools.description: detach a child issue from its parent

tools.name: list_sub_issues
tools.description: list the real sub-issues of a given issue

tools.name: set_blocked_by
tools.description: make an issue's real blocked_by edges match a given list exactly, adding missing and removing stale

tools.name: list_blocked_by
tools.description: real current blockers of an issue plus their live GitHub state

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: the audit trail of what each connected chat or session has actually done through this server

tools.name: batch_reparent_sub_issues
tools.description: bulk remove/add sub-issue parent moves, sequential, independent per-item success/failure reporting

tools.name: batch_move_to_status
tools.description: bulk board-status moves, same real 5-value vocabulary and per-item validation as move_to_status

tools.name: batch_close_issues
tools.description: bulk closing, same real per-item close_issue logic including the NOT_PLANNED-needs-a-comment rule

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: one real file's actual text by repo-root-relative case-sensitive path, optional ref pins a branch tag or commit sha, reports truncated or binary honestly instead of returning mangled or empty text

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: one directory's real entries (name, path, type, size), non-recursive, capped at 1000 entries with truncated reporting

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: GitHub code-search syntax scoped to the repo, reports which of two real backends (code-search index or repo-tree-paths fallback) actually answered

servers.name: Shanes-Life-Production
servers.note: Shane's personal 'Shane's Life' app — entirely outside this repo. No per-tool name/description text exists anywhere in this codebase for it. The real tool COUNT (92) is Shane's own direct observation, recorded verbatim in Git #3724's issue body — not fabricated — but the per-tool schema text genuinely is not available here, so its token overhead is extrapolated from shanes-git's own real measured average tokens/tool (see ChatContextOverheadEstimator.cs), not measured directly.
